---
title: "Freyja Analysis Results Visualization"
output:
  pdf_document: default
  html_notebook: default
---

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(zoo)
library(rprojroot)
library(eoffice)
library(stringr)
library(gridExtra)

# Define CNS color palette
cns_colors <- c("#bdbdbd","#4DBBD5", "#00A087", "#3C5488", "#F39B7F", "#8491B4", "#91D1C2",  "#7E6148", "#B09C85", "#4a1486", "#e8743c","#6a51a3", "#8264CC", "#3C5488B2", "#0072B2", "#4387B5", "#5D90BA", "#56B4E9", "#4DBBD5B2", "#2EBEBE", "#009E73", "#167153", "#4c9568", "#356d67", "#74B346", "#7CC767", "#b0d45d","#E64B35", "#7fb961", "#8EA325", "#A9D179", "#91D1C2B2", "#84CAC0", "#F1CC2F", "#D8D155", "#ffe788", "#ffc556", "#F5AE6B", "#eb998b", "#cca69c", "#BCB8D3", "#8491B4B2", "#9e9ac8", "#737373", "#999999",  "#9ecae1", "#76afda", "#abddff", "#dcf2ff", "#fddbc8","#252525", "#562e3c", "#7A142C",  "#E64B35B2",  "#223D6C", "#004529", "#42465c", "#7d4444", "#9e6c69", "#8c510a", "#A14462", "#a14462",  "#bf812d", "#D55E00",  "#E0367A", "#df65b0", "#CC79A7")

# Read the file path of the data
tNGS_lineage_file <- sprintf("%s/data/tNGS_lineage_abundances.tsv", find_rstudio_root_file())
HybCapSeq_lineage_file <- sprintf("%s/data/HybCapSeq_lineage_abundances.tsv", find_rstudio_root_file())
tNGS_summarized_file <- sprintf("%s/data/tNGS_summarized_abundances.tsv", find_rstudio_root_file())
HybCapSeq_summarized_file <- sprintf("%s/data/HybCapSeq_summarized_abundances.tsv", find_rstudio_root_file())

tNGS_metadata_file <- sprintf("%s/data/tNGS_times_metadata.csv", find_rstudio_root_file())
HybCapSeq_metadata_file <- sprintf("%s/data/HybCapSeq_times_metadata.csv", find_rstudio_root_file())

# Read metadata files using read_tsv to handle tab-separated values
tNGS_metadata <- read_tsv(tNGS_metadata_file) %>%
  mutate(Method = "tNGS")

HybCapSeq_metadata <- read_tsv(HybCapSeq_metadata_file) %>%
  mutate(Method = "HybCapSeq")

# Combine metadata
all_metadata <- bind_rows(tNGS_metadata, HybCapSeq_metadata) %>%
  # Convert date to week format (e.g., 2024-W01)
  mutate(
    sample_collection_datetime = as.Date(sample_collection_datetime, format = "%Y/%m/%d"),
    Week = paste0(year(sample_collection_datetime), "-W", sprintf("%02d", week(sample_collection_datetime)))
  )

# Function to process abundance files
process_abundance_file <- function(file_path, method) {
  # Read the TSV file
  data <- read_tsv(file_path)
  
  # Convert to long format
  long_data <- data %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Sample, names_to = "Lineage", values_to = "Abundance") %>%
    # Remove rows with zero abundance to reduce data size
    filter(Abundance > 0) %>%
    # Add method column
    mutate(Method = method)
  
  return(long_data)
}

# Process all abundance files
tNGS_lineage_data <- process_abundance_file(tNGS_lineage_file, "tNGS")
HybCapSeq_lineage_data <- process_abundance_file(HybCapSeq_lineage_file, "HybCapSeq")
tNGS_summarized_data <- process_abundance_file(tNGS_summarized_file, "tNGS")
HybCapSeq_summarized_data <- process_abundance_file(HybCapSeq_summarized_file, "HybCapSeq")

# Combine lineage data and add week information
combined_lineage_data <- bind_rows(tNGS_lineage_data, HybCapSeq_lineage_data) %>%
  left_join(all_metadata, by = c("Sample" = "Sample", "Method" = "Method")) %>%
  select(Week, Lineage, Abundance, Method)

# Combine summarized data and add week information
combined_summarized_data <- bind_rows(tNGS_summarized_data, HybCapSeq_summarized_data) %>%
  left_join(all_metadata, by = c("Sample" = "Sample", "Method" = "Method")) %>%
  select(Week, Lineage, Abundance, Method)

# Function to filter weeks where both methods have data
filter_common_weeks <- function(data) {
  # Get weeks where both methods have data
  weeks_with_both_methods <- data %>%
    group_by(Week, Method) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Method, values_from = count, values_fill = 0) %>%
    filter(tNGS > 0 & HybCapSeq > 0) %>%
    pull(Week)
  
  # Filter original data to keep only those weeks
  filtered_data <- data %>%
    filter(Week %in% weeks_with_both_methods)
  
  return(filtered_data)
}

# Function to calculate relative abundance within each week and method
calculate_relative_abundance <- function(data) {
  relative_data <- data %>%
    # Group by week, method, and lineage to sum abundances of the same lineage in the same week
    group_by(Week, Method, Lineage) %>%
    summarise(TotalAbundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
    # Calculate total abundance per week and method
    group_by(Week, Method) %>%
    mutate(
      WeekTotal = sum(TotalAbundance),
      RelativeAbundance = TotalAbundance / WeekTotal
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(Week, Lineage, Abundance = RelativeAbundance, Method)
  
  return(relative_data)
}

# Function to order lineages by average relative abundance
order_lineages_by_abundance <- function(data) {
  # Calculate average abundance for each lineage across all weeks and methods
  lineage_order <- data %>%
    group_by(Lineage) %>%
    summarise(AvgAbundance = mean(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(AvgAbundance)) %>%
    pull(Lineage)
  
  # Convert Lineage to ordered factor
  data$Lineage <- factor(data$Lineage, levels = lineage_order)
  
  return(data)
}

# Filter data to include only weeks with both methods
filtered_lineage_data <- filter_common_weeks(combined_lineage_data)
filtered_summarized_data <- filter_common_weeks(combined_summarized_data)

# Calculate relative abundance
relative_lineage_data <- calculate_relative_abundance(filtered_lineage_data)
relative_summarized_data <- calculate_relative_abundance(filtered_summarized_data)

# Order lineages by average relative abundance
ordered_lineage_data <- order_lineages_by_abundance(relative_lineage_data)
ordered_summarized_data <- order_lineages_by_abundance(relative_summarized_data)

# Function to create stacked bar plot with CNS colors and custom theme
create_stacked_bar_plot <- function(data, filename_prefix) {
  # Create the plot with CNS color palette and custom theme
  plot <- ggplot(data, aes(x = Week, y = Abundance, fill = Lineage)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
    facet_wrap(~ Method, ncol = 1) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = NULL,
      x = "Week",
      y = "Relative Abundance"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cns_colors)
  
  # Save as PDF
  pdf_file <- sprintf("%s/charts/%s.pdf", find_rstudio_root_file(), filename_prefix)
  ggsave(pdf_file, plot, width = 12, height = 8)
  
  # Save as PPTX using topptx
  pptx_file <- sprintf("%s/charts/%s.pptx", find_rstudio_root_file(), filename_prefix)
    topptx(plot, filename = pptx_file, height = 8, width = 12)
  
  return(plot)
}

# Create and save plots for ordered data
lineage_plot <- create_stacked_bar_plot(
  ordered_lineage_data, 
  "lineage_relative_abundance_by_week_method"
)

summarized_plot <- create_stacked_bar_plot(
  ordered_summarized_data, 
  "summarized_relative_abundance_by_week_method"
)

# Display plots
lineage_plot
summarized_plot

# Save processed data
write_tsv(ordered_lineage_data, sprintf("%s/charts/lineage_relative_abundance_data.tsv", find_rstudio_root_file()))
write_tsv(ordered_summarized_data, sprintf("%s/charts/summarized_relative_abundance_data.tsv", find_rstudio_root_file()))

cat("Analysis completed. Plots saved to charts directory.\n")
```
